Current release queue, 7 October 2026: release-later; milestone-maintenance.
Plan: docs/refactor/RELEASE-QUEUE.md. Mote remains authoritative; one primary agent and at most one helper.

Reconciliation: At 8d4881a the filename mismatch remains. Original suite ecc0bc2f is on main; the rename has not landed. Independent read-only audit.

Remaining / next action: Rename corpus B1ProbeSuite.scala to SegmentLinkCompositionSuite.scala with byte-identical content and matching class. Check the affected suite/discovery; no behavior refactor.

Release tags schedule work; they do not establish completion or empirical qualification. Use current AGENTS.md for ownership, scoped gates and exact-SHA review; old fleet roles, timers and fixed gate task counts are historical. Keep the original scientific preregistration, denominators, admission and sealed-test rules below.

Retained acceptance and design context:

Scheduling lane: maintenance. Governing plan: docs/refactor/PLAN.md.

Current disposition, 2026-09-19: Keep the test-file rename as an optional narrow cleanup; it does not gate the preview or scientific claim.

Historical finding and scope retained below; current acceptance ownership above governs.

corpus/src/test/scala/storymodel4s/corpus/B1ProbeSuite.scala contains `class SegmentLinkCompositionSuite`. File and class disagree because rm and mv were both denied in the session that wrote it (2026-09-17). `git mv` it to SegmentLinkCompositionSuite.scala; no content change. Trivial.
